title: MARBLE: An in vivo MRI marker of limbic-predominant age-related TDP-43 encephalopathy neuropathologic change (LATE-NC).
authors: Tazwar, Mahir; Evia, Arnold M; Ridwan, Abdur R; Leurgans, Sue E; Wagner, Maude; Bennett, David A; Schneider, Julie A; Arfanakis, Konstantinos
journal: Alzheimer's & dementia : the journal of the Alzheimer's Association
one_liner_zh: 该文利用机器学习在MRI上预测TDP-43脑病神经病理改变，但对象为脑影像与神经病理，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: INTRODUCTION: Limbic-predominant age-related transactive response DNA binding protein 43 kDa encephalopathy neuropathologic change (LATE-NC) is common in older adults, yet definitive diagnosis is only possible at autopsy. METHODS: This work developed a fully automated in vivo marker of LATE-NC named MARBLE (MARker of Brain LatE) by applying machine learning methods on brain magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and neuropathology data from 918 community-based older adults. RESULTS: Testing MARBLE in an independent group of older adults, with ante mortem intervals between MRI and death of < 3 years, achieved an area under the curve = 0.92 for in vivo prediction of LATE-NC. Moreover, a higher MARBLE score was associated with higher LATE-NC stages (beta = 0.083, 95% confidence interval = [0.053, 0.113], p < 10(-4)), and a lower level and accelerated decline of cognition, with the strongest effects observed in episodic and semantic memory, and perceptual speed (p < 10(-4)). DISCUSSION: MARBLE is an automated in vivo MRI-based marker of LATE-NC holding significant promise for enhancing diagnosis, refining clinical trial enrollment, and advancing targeted therapeutic approaches.
abstract_zh: 引言：边缘系统为主的年龄相关TAR DNA结合蛋白43 kDa脑病神经病理改变（LATE-NC）在老年人中常见，但确诊仅能通过尸检实现。方法：本研究通过将机器学习方法应用于来自918名社区老年人的脑部磁共振成像（MRI）和神经病理学数据，开发了一种名为MARBLE（脑部LATE标志物）的全自动LATE-NC体内标志物。结果：在独立的老年人组中测试MARBLE，其MRI与死亡之间的生前间隔小于3年，对LATE-NC的体内预测实现了曲线下面积=0.92。此外，较高的MARBLE评分与较高的LATE-NC分期相关（β=0.083，95%置信区间=[0.053, 0.113]，p<10(-4)），并与较低认知水平及加速认知衰退相关，其中在情景记忆、语义记忆和知觉速度方面效应最强（p<10(-4)）。讨论：MARBLE是一种基于MRI的LATE-NC自动体内标志物，在增强诊断、优化临床试验入组及推进靶向治疗方法方面具有显著潜力。
